deliverables: WP 1 - Intersect operations and ecosystem coordination: 6,000,000 ADA
WP 2 - Technical Stewardship, Incident Response & Coordination including core Cardano repos: 18,800,000 ADA
WP 3 - Management of critical processes: 600,000 ADA
request.recipient: Intersect, via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stated in the document.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination and technical stewardship for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect says the proposal funds its core operating model for June 2026 to June 2027, including governance coordination, reserved capacity for critical unowned processes, and technical stewardship.
Intersect says the total ask has decreased from $7.875M last year to $6.35M while preserving functions critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect claims it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting results and audit materials.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission time and links to the referenced governance action.

The document states independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, including possible deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.
Intersect discloses that it and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA from three listed Cardano Treasury governance actions within the past 24 months.

Intersect says it will administer the funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses and links to guides, repositories, audits, and a public dashboard.

The proposal states the smart contract configuration uses five Intersect admins, three Intersect leadership roles, and a six-entity external Oversight Committee with specified multi-party authorization thresholds for key actions.
The proposal states all TRSC and PSSC instances cannot be staked with an SPO and are delegated to the auto-abstain predefined DRep.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect operations, technical stewardship, incident response, coordination, and critical process management, with milestone and smart-contract administration mechanisms described and multiple external references provided for voting, NCL, and contract audit verification.
